spec.basis: Andrew Fisher, 31 Oct 2026 (this chat, ~03:4x AEST): 'Kinp is easy just assign who ever is working to that' and 'The generators. Is just an hour each from aaron mob and demob for each generator'. KINP per-piece labour (install, levelling, steps and cleaning on the day a unit came on site; demob on the day it left) goes to every person on the roster that day, as a note on their labour row naming the contract and the units, the rest of the day after any hours already noted; the generators go to one person at one hour per generator on its day in and its day out, as a note on that person's row (a new row where the roster had none that day). Rows' own hours and times untouched. Nothing inferred beyond those two rules. One labour-hire row (15 Oct) already carries a note at the page's 240-character limit and cannot take the KINP words; its KINP share is the rest of that day by the same rule, recorded here instead.
